title: Raw Seed: From Cardputer OBD2 Diagnostics to Capsule Swarm Nervous System
description: Raw contextual seed preserving the origin trace before normalization: a practical Cardputer/ESP32-TWAI-CAN field diagnostic story, the user's interpretation as an electronic nervous system, the author's positive reply, the future-facing JANUS capsule/swarm projection, and later architecture questions inspired by a forensic study of Fallout 3 Vault 112. primary_external_seed.raw_interpretation: ESP32/CAN/TWAI communication layer for embedded systems; useful as a practical bridge between small controllers and larger machine state.

author_context_raw_summary.source: Reddit author preface shared by Hawkar
author_context_raw_summary.role: maintenance engineer at a remote construction site
author_context_raw_summary.problem: Fuel quality issues, often using old dirty diesel, causing injector failures especially on smaller vehicles like a Mitsubishi L200.
author_context_raw_summary.constraint: Heavy construction machinery had professional diagnostic laptops, but the smaller pickup trucks did not have a standard OBD2 scanner available.
author_context_raw_summary.old_school_method: Pull injector connectors one by one while the engine idles and observe vibration change.
author_context_raw_summary.chosen_path: Use the situation as an excuse to combine electronics hobby with work.
author_context_raw_summary.implemented_tool: Custom C++ Cardputer script using ESP32-TWAI-CAN to send an OBD2 Mode 03 request to the engine ECU and retrieve stored DTCs.
author_context_raw_summary.warning_logic: If the hexadecimal response indicates fuel or misfire issues starting with 02 or 03, the Cardputer flashes a red INJECTOR/FUEL warning.

vault112_architecture_observation_layer.source_context: Fallout 3 Vault 112 / Tranquility Lane forensic study in janus-meta-registry

observed_architecture_pattern.per_capsule_endpoint: Each subject can have a distinct physical lounger/session endpoint rather than a single undifferentiated shared endpoint.
observed_architecture_pattern.per_capsule_local_shard: A useful architecture hypothesis is a local capsule shard responsible for immediate sensor/telemetry/rendering or local session functions.
observed_architecture_pattern.central_coordinator: A separate central processing layer can coordinate many capsule sessions without erasing local identity boundaries.
observed_architecture_pattern.privileged_admin_plane: Administrative authority should be separated from ordinary user-visible control surfaces; privileged operations require explicit authentication, audit and bounded authority.
observed_architecture_pattern.telemetry_vs_memory_state: Vital telemetry/session metadata must be modeled separately from autobiographical, identity or persistent state. Seeing a monitor value is not proof of a memory backup.
observed_architecture_pattern.portable_state_carrier: Portable state/media should carry explicit provenance, source identity, capture time, scope and integrity metadata; an anonymous state blob must not silently become authoritative truth.
observed_architecture_pattern.session_exit_semantics: Leaving an active session should define what is destroyed, what is retained, what is archived and who can retrieve it.
observed_architecture_pattern.swarm_rule: A central coordinator may observe and compare capsule states but must not become an unbounded master override over safety-critical local controllers.

engineering_questions_derived_from_ficti: What state belongs locally to one capsule and what state belongs to the central coordinator?
Which data must persist across a capsule reboot, disconnect or session exit?
How is a persistent session object uniquely bound to exactly one capsule and one authorized subject?
Can telemetry be reconstructed without storing sensitive identity/memory content?
If portable state exists, is it append-only, rewritable, cloneable or one-time, and how is provenance preserved?
What happens when a local capsule shard and the central coordinator disagree about current state?
Which functions remain available when the central coordinator is unreachable?
How are administrator actions independently logged and prevented from silently rewriting subject history?
How can a simulator prove recovery semantics using synthetic/phantom data before any safety-critical deployment?

recommended_nonmedical_testbench_mapping.capsule_endpoint: ESP32/Cardputer node with synthetic sensors only
recommended_nonmedical_testbench_mapping.local_shard: local state machine and ring-buffer logger
recommended_nonmedical_testbench_mapping.central_coordinator: Buzz/JANUS software simulator coordinating multiple synthetic capsule nodes
recommended_nonmedical_testbench_mapping.admin_plane: separate authenticated maintenance interface with immutable audit receipts
recommended_nonmedical_testbench_mapping.session_store: explicit session metadata object with capsule_id, session_id, start/end anchors and integrity hash
recommended_nonmedical_testbench_mapping.portable_state_carrier: test-only signed JSON/CBOR state artifact, never human biological data
recommended_nonmedical_testbench_mapping.recovery_test: kill/restart/disconnect nodes and verify deterministic safe restoration of synthetic state without actuator authority

anti_overclaim: Vault 112 does not validate real biostasis, cryosleep, medical torpor or consciousness storage.
Fictional memory transfer is not evidence that human memory can be digitized or restored.
The analogy is used only to improve modularity, provenance, persistence semantics, fault recovery and safety architecture.
Any future human-facing medical system requires independent medical, ethical, regulatory and hardware validation far beyond this seed.
